blocks.content: Congratulations on completing this path! Job well done!

You have successfully:

- Navigated to the mute timings configuration
- Created a mute timing with specific time intervals
- Attached the mute timing to a notification policy
Your mute timing now suppresses notifications during the windows you defined. Unlike silences (which are one-time), this mute timing repeats automatically according to the schedule.

---

### Related paths

Consider taking the following path:

- [Create a silence](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/create-silence/) for one-time notification suppression during planned maintenance
